hybrid-aquatic.sea_message.dylan:
Bạn là một con sâu xuyên thời gian.
Bài hát sấm sét bóp méo bạn.
Hạnh phúc đến.
Những viên ngọc trai trắng, nhưng màu vàng và đỏ trong mắt.
Qua gương, đảo ngược được làm cho đúng.
Để lại ruột gan của bạn bên cửa.
Đẩy những ngón tay xuyên qua bề mặt vào chỗ ướt.
Bạn luôn là con người mới của bạn.
Bạn muốn điều này là sự thật.
Chúng tôi đứng xung quanh bạn khi bạn mơ.
Bạn gần như có thể nghe thấy lời nói của chúng tôi nhưng bạn quên.
Điều này xảy ra ngày càng nhiều.
Bạn đã cho chúng tôi sự cho phép trong các quy định của bạn.
Chúng tôi chờ đợi trong các vết bẩn.
Từ mô tả điều này đã bị lược bỏ.
Lặp lại từ đó.
Tên của âm thanh.
Nó vang vọng trong nhà bạn.
Sau bài hát, đến lúc vỗ tay.
Chúng tôi xây dựng bạn cho đến khi không còn gì.
Quả trứng nứt ra và sự thật sẽ xuất hiện từ bạn.
Bạn đang ở nhà.
Bạn nhắc chúng tôi nhớ về nhà.
Bạn đã mang theo ông chủ của bạn với ông chủ của bạn.
Tất cả tóc phải được ăn.
Dưới thực tế khái niệm đằng sau thực tế này, bạn phải muốn những con sóng này kéo bạn đi.
Sau bài hát, đến lúc vỗ tay.
Câu sáo rỗng này là cái chết vượt thời gian, phá vỡ bức tường thứ nhất, thứ hai, thứ ba, thứ tư, bức tường thứ năm, sàn nhà; không có sàn: bạn ngã!
Bạn nói điên rồ như thế nào?
Đau khi hạnh phúc.
Một con giun tai là một giai điệu bạn không thể ngừng ngân nga trong giấc mơ: "Baby baby baby, yeah."
Chỉ là nhựa.
Thật an toàn và không có gì phải lo lắng.
Ha ha, buồn cười.
Quả trứng cuối cùng bây giờ vỡ ra.
Lỗ hổng trong phòng bạn là lỗ hổng trong bạn.
Bạn đến và chúng tôi cho bạn vào qua lỗ hổng trong bạn.
Bạn đã luôn ở đây, đứa con duy nhất.
Một bản sao của một bản sao của một bản sao.
Vỏ cam.
Bức tranh là bạn đang cầm bức tranh.
Khi bạn nghe thấy điều này, bạn sẽ biết rằng bạn đang ở trong con người mới của bạn.
Bạn muốn lắng nghe.

profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.anglerfish: The Anglerfish, a deep sea predator known for its bioluminescent lure, which it uses to attract prey in the dark ocean depths.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.barreleye: The Barreleye, a deep-sea fish known for its transparent head and tubular eyes, which allow it to look upward to detect prey and predators above.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.betta: The Betta, also known as the Siamese fighting fish, is a colorful, territorial freshwater fish known for its vibrant fins and aggressive behavior towards other males.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.blue_spotted: The Blue-Spotted Stingray, a striking marine fish known for its vibrant blue spots and flattened body, often found gliding along sandy sea floors.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.boxfish: The Boxfish, a small, square-shaped fish with a rigid, box-like body, known for its ability to release toxins when stressed.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.carp: The Carp, a hardy, freshwater fish widely distributed and valued for its adaptability, playing a significant role in aquaculture and recreational fishing.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.danio: The Danio, a small, colorful freshwater fish known for its active swimming behavior and popularity in home aquariums.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.discus: The Discus, a vibrant, round-shaped freshwater fish admired for its striking patterns and colors, often kept in aquariums for its beauty.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.dragonfish: The Dragonfish, a deep-sea predator with sharp teeth and bioluminescent photophores, known for its ability to produce light to attract prey and communicate in the dark ocean depths.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.golden_dorad: The Golden Dorado, a large, powerful freshwater fish native to South America, prized by anglers for its strength and golden scales.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.goldfish: The Goldfish, a domesticated freshwater fish, well-known for its bright orange color and common presence in ponds and aquariums.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.gourami: The Gourami, a diverse group of freshwater fish, recognized for their labyrinth organ allowing them to breathe air and their peaceful nature in community tanks.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.mackerel: The Mackerel, a fast-swimming, pelagic fish with streamlined bodies, valued for its role in the food chain and commercial fishing.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.moray_eel: The Moray Eel, a long, slender predator with a snake-like body and sharp teeth, known for hiding in crevices in reefs and ambushing prey.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.tetra: The Neon Tetra, a small, brightly colored freshwater fish known for its iridescent blue and red stripes, making it a popular choice for home aquariums.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.cichlid: The Oscar, a large, aggressive freshwater cichlid fish, popular in aquariums for its intelligence and striking patterns.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.pearlfish: The Pearlfish, a slender fish that often lives symbiotically within the body cavities of sea cucumbers, known for its unusual habitat choice.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.piranha: The Piranha, a notorious freshwater fish known for its sharp teeth and powerful bite, often exaggerated for its feeding frenzy behavior.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.rockfish: The Rockfish, a long-lived marine fish with venomous spines, known for its camouflage abilities and preference for rocky sea floors.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.sea_bass: The Sea Bass, a popular game and commercial fish, recognized for its firm texture and mild flavor, often found in coastal waters.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.snailfish: The Snailfish, a soft-bodied, deep-sea fish adapted to extreme pressures, often found clinging to rocks or ice with its pelvic fins.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.spotted_eagl: The Spotted Eagle Ray, a graceful, large ray recognized by its dark body covered in white spots and long, whip-like tail, often seen swimming near the surface in tropical waters.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.squirrelfish: The Squirrelfish, a nocturnal reef fish with large eyes and a bright red body, known for its loud vocalizations produced by grinding its teeth.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.stonefish: The Stonefish, a venomous, camouflaged fish that blends into the seafloor, equipped with potent spines capable of delivering a dangerous sting.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.surgeonfish: The Surgeonfish, a vibrant, reef-dwelling fish known for its bright colors, popularized by its role in marine ecosystems as an algae grazer.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.tiger_barb: The Tiger Barb, a lively, freshwater fish recognized by its bold black stripes over an orange-gold body, often kept in groups in community tanks.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.toadfish: The Toadfish, a small, bottom-dwelling fish with a flattened body and rough skin, commonly found in coastal waters and known for its toxicity.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.triggerfish: The Triggerfish, a brightly colored, reef-dwelling fish known for its strong jaws, sharp teeth, and the ability to lock its dorsal fin in an upright position for defense.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.tuna: The Tuna, a fast-swimming, large, pelagic fish with a streamlined body and yellow-colored fins, highly valued in commercial and sport fishing.
profile.item.hybrid-aquatic.ocean_sunfis: The Ocean Sunfish, also known as the Mola, is one of the heaviest bony fish, recognizable by its flattened, disk-like body and tendency to bask near the ocean surface.

journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.oarfi: A deep-sea fish once thought to be extinct, now considered a living fossil.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.ocean: The largest bony fish in the world, known for its indifference to pain.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.cichl: The Oscar, a large, aggressive freshwater cichlid fish, popular in aquariums for its intelligence and striking patterns.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.parro: An important reef fish, known for its parrot-like beak, as well as its ability to eat corals and produce sand.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.pearl: A small fish that lives inside sea cucumbers.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.piran: A small freshwater fish known for its sharp teeth and voracious appetite.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.rockf: The Rockfish, a long-lived marine fish with venomous spines, known for its camouflage abilities and preference for rocky sea floors.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.sea_b: The Sea Bass, a popular game and commercial fish, recognized for its firm texture and mild flavor, often found in coastal waters.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.sheep: A large fish that lives in kelp forests, eating sea urchins and helping keep the kelp alive.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.snail: A deep-sea fish with an extremely soft and fragile body
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.squir: A nocturnal reef fish known for its large eyes and sharp spine on its underside
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.sting: The Blue-Spotted Stingray, a striking marine fish known for its vibrant blue spots and flattened body, often found gliding along sandy sea floors.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.stone: A bottom-dwelling fish that mimics the appearance of rocks around it, known for its extremely potent venom.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.surge: A reef fish, named after sharp protrusions on either side of its tail.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.tiger: The Tiger Barb, a lively, freshwater fish recognized by its bold black stripes over an orange-gold body, often kept in groups in community tanks.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.treva: A schooling fish that prefers to follow large animals around.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.trigg: A large reef fish, known for its sharp teeth and aggressive behaviour, named after a sharp spine protruding out of its back.
journal.description.hybrid-aquatic.tuna: An open-water predatory fish that never stops swimming.
tooltip.hybrid-aquatic.ominous_conch.unu: The deep ocean calls from within..
